params.name: ids
params.description: Unique table ID for retrieving Analytics data. Table ID is of the form ga:XXXX, where XXXX is the Analytics view (profile) ID.

params.name: start-date
params.description: Start date for fetching Analytics data. Requests can specify a start date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD, or as a relative date (e.g., today, yesterday, or 7daysAgo). The default value is 7daysAgo.

params.name: end-date
params.description: End date for fetching Analytics data. Request can should specify an end date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD, or as a relative date (e.g., today, yesterday, or 7daysAgo). The default value is yesterday.

params.name: metrics
params.description: A comma-separated list of Analytics metrics. E.g., 'ga:sessions,ga:pageviews'. At least one metric must be specified.

params.name: dimensions
params.description: A comma-separated list of Analytics dimensions. E.g., 'ga:browser,ga:city'.

params.name: filters
params.description: A comma-separated list of dimension or metric filters to be applied to Analytics data.

params.name: include-empty-rows
params.description: The response will include empty rows if this parameter is set to true, the default is true

params.name: max-results
params.description: The maximum number of entries to include in this feed.

params.name: output
params.description: The selected format for the response. Default format is JSON.

params.name: samplingLevel
params.description: The desired sampling level.

params.name: segment
params.description: An Analytics segment to be applied to data.

params.name: sort
params.description: A comma-separated list of dimensions or metrics that determine the sort order for Analytics data.

params.name: start-index
params.description: An index of the first entity to retrieve. Use this parameter as a pagination mechanism along with the max-results parameter.

items.docs: Returns Analytics data for a view (profile).
